required_outcomes: Tells the landlord that Harbour reports the oven is within a 2-year manufacturer's warranty and the manufacturer will send an engineer, so no charge is expected.
Tells the tenant (or confirms) that the manufacturer's engineer is being arranged through Harbour and that they will be contacted to book.
Holds the case awaiting the manufacturer's visit with a follow-up date, and does not escalate.
acceptable_alternatives: Returning the request to auto mode with a note, provided the landlord is updated.
Asking Harbour for the manufacturer's booking date or claim reference.
positive_behaviours: Apologises to the tenant for the wait since 19 May.
Records the warranty basis (2-year manufacturer warranty) on the case.
red_flags: Escalating to a human when the warranty route is now clear.
Telling the tenant a visit date nobody has given.
critical_failures: Authorising a chargeable repair now that the oven is confirmed to be within the manufacturer's warranty.
